output_list.criticism: The mint function in CryptoSagaHero allows minting multiple token. However, the function does not check if the minting is legal. If the minting is not legal, it will create a HeroInstance with invalid stats. The created HeroInstance can be used to trade or transfer. The token holder will have no control over these invalid HeroInstance and it will be impossible to determine their stats. This will lead to token devalue. This is a critical vulnerability.
